[[File:Malak_kotorpromo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Malak, who notably bore the title of Magnus]]
{{Quote|Well, facts are facts. Here's another one: ''Magnus'' is a Sith title.|Halagad Ventor, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Magnus''' was a title claimed by self-anointed rulers of the most ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. It could be translated as "All-Powerful," "[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of Lords," or "[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]."<ref name="swcw" /> [[Darth Malak]], who reigned as a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], was referred to as a "Sith Magnus."<ref name="korcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] terrorist in league with [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] took the alias of "[[Zeta Magnus]]"<ref name="swcw" /> to throw the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] off Sidious's scent and to subtly mock the legitimate [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52481014|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" Hits the Internet!|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2015-06-24|time=8:25 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180314003734/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/page-7}}</ref> It worked to an extent, as the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]] [[Halagad Ventor]] mistakenly suspected that the genetic terrorist might have ties with the Sith of old.<ref name="swcw" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Magnus was created by [[Abel G. Peña]] for the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2008]]. However, the guide did not elaborate on its meaning.<ref name="korcg" /> Upon being asked about it, Peña himself stated in [[2011]] that he could not yet give a precise answer to that question.<ref name="SWBoards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=243200&start=80&tstart=0#17953712|thread=The Official Abel G. Peña Thread (Halagad Approved)|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad]]|date=2011-02-10|time=9:46 PM}}</ref> In [[2015]], however, the title reappeared in the [[EBook|eNovella]] ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'', in which Peña finally explained the origin and meaning of Magnus.<ref name="swcw" />
